players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.summary: Love was diagnosed Tuesday with a right high-ankle sprain, which is expected to send him to injured reserve and keep him out for 4-to-5 weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Kendrick Bourne
players.summary: Bourne (ankle) is expected to miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan Jones of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Bam Knight
players.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur revealed Monday that Knight is in the concussion protocol following Sunday's overtime win in Dallas, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.summary: Wilson said after Sunday's 33-30 win at Dallas that he suffered two broken ribs during the contest, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.summary: Coach Kevin Stefanski noted Monday that Branch (hamstring) won't play Sunday against the Bengals, William McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: Beaux Collins
players.summary: Collins (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers and will remain on injured reserve, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: Tyler Huntley
players.summary: Huntley (toe) wasn't spotted practicing Tuesday, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Joe Fagnano
players.summary: Fagnano practiced Tuesday "with a significant guard/brace on his right ankle," Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Justice Hill
players.summary: Hill (groin) was estimated as a limited participant on Monday's practice report.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said after Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills that Jackson will undergo surgery to address his right thumb injury and will be placed on injured reserve,  Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.summary: Moore indicated following Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens that he's okay in the wake of his late-game exit due to a knee issue, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Joshua Palmer
players.summary: Palmer (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Ravens.

players.name: Xavier Legette
players.summary: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Legette (knee) will "potentially" be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.summary: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Brooks (core) will "potentially" be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.summary: Iosivas (thumb) is making good progress in his rehab, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

players.name: Erick All Jr.
players.summary: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

players.name: Luke Schoonmaker
players.summary: questionable

players.name: KaVontae Turpin
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.summary: Head coach Brian Schottenheimer said Monday that Ferguson (ankle) has a chance to play Sunday at Indianapolis, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.summary: The Broncos placed Harvey (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Jacob Saylors
players.summary: Saylors (neck) is not expected to practice Wednesday, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

players.name: Isiah Pacheco
players.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.summary: Packers passing game coordinator Jason Vrable said Monday that Watson (ribs) is sore but "doing great," Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he has "no significant update" on the status of Montgomery (groin) heading into a Week 9 matchup with the Chargers, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

players.name: Jaylin Noel
players.summary: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

players.name: Anthony Gould
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.summary: Tuten (ankle/foot) was not spotted during the portion of Tuesday's practice open to the media, according to Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.summary: Rodriguez was listed as limited on Monday's practice estimate due to a hand injury.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.summary: Meyers logged two catches for 24 yards on three targets in Sunday's 42-7 win against Indianapolis.

players.name: Carter Runyon
players.summary: Runyon (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.summary: Thompson (quadriceps/hamstring) is not expected to practice this week, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

players.name: David Njoku
players.summary: Coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday that the Chargers likely will open the 21-day window for Njoku (fibula) this week, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

players.name: Colby Parkinson
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Dean Connors
players.summary: Connors suffered a broken hand in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Chargers.

players.name: Matthew Stafford
players.summary: Stafford left the locker room after Sunday's 24-9 win over the Chargers with a bag of ice wrapped on his right arm, and Rams coach Sean McVay acknowledged Monday that the quarterback has been dealing with some arm soreness, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.summary: Coach Sean McVay said Monday that it is "looking more likely than not" Ferguson (ankle) will practice this week, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.summary: Head coach Sean McVay said Wednesday that Adams had successful surgery on his left hamstring, and the Rams are hopeful that the wide receiver will be able to return on the early side of his 6-to-10-week recovery timetable, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Murray has a sore hamstring and will undergo a full evaluation as the Vikings look to determine the extent of the issue, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.summary: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he had no update on Henry's (foot) status heading into Sunday's game against the Packers, Karen Guregian of MassLive.com reports. "I don't have any expectations yet," Vrabel said of Henry. "It's kind of how he responds here. He wasn't able to finish the [Week 8] game. So we'll see where he is, and I know Hunter will do everything he can to get back to help us."

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Mack Hollins
players.summary: Hollins (calf), who is eligible to be activated from IR this week, per Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald, could return to practice Wednesday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.summary: When asked whether Brown (ankle/knee) might practice at some point this week, coach Mike Vrabel said Monday, "We'll see," Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.summary: Head coach Kellen Moore said that Etienne (hamstring) will be evaluated Monday before the Saints make a determination whether he practices this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.summary: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said that the Saints will decide by Wednesday whether to open Tyson's (hamstring) 21-day practice window this week, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

players.name: CJ Donaldson
players.summary: Donaldson (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris.

players.name: Theo Johnson
players.summary: Johnson (neck) participated during practice Monday, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.summary: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said that Skattebo (hamstring) is day-to-day and could end up being a game-time decision for Sunday's tilt with the Eagles, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
players.summary: The Giants placed Tracy (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.summary: Hall (quadriceps) is considered "good to go" and is expected to return to action in next Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.summary: questionable

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Britain Covey
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Dameon Pierce
players.summary: The Eagles placed Pierce (undisclosed) on injured reserve Wednesday

players.name: Ben Skowronek
players.summary: out

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.summary: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.summary: Stribling (ankle) was spotted Monday walking without crutches or a brace on his lower leg, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.summary: Aiyuk is close to hiring new representation and is expected to file for reinstatement to the NFL in the near future, according to NFL reporter Jordan Schultz.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.summary: Samuel (hamstring) has a chance to return following the 49ers' Week 8 bye, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

players.name: Demarcus Robinson
players.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan reiterated Monday that Robinson (ankle) has a chance to return following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.summary: Evans (Achilles) is expected to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.summary: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

players.name: Rashid Shaheed
players.summary: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Tuesday that Shaheed (knee) has a chance to play Sunday against the Cardinals, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Velus Jones Jr.
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Drew Lock
players.summary: Lock (coach's decision/elbow) is inactive for Monday's matchup with the Bears but serving as the team's emergency quarterback, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.summary: out

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.summary: out

players.name: Jeremy McNichols
players.summary: McNichols is getting additional opinions on the foot injury that he suffered Sunday against the Eagles, but there's an expectation that he'll miss multiple months, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.summary: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jaylin Lane
players.summary: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.
